description: Perform scoped network operations like scanning the local network for devices or fetching remote resources.

fetch_url.description: Download the content of a remote URL.

scan_local_network.description: Scan the local network for active devices and services.

target.description: Target IP, CIDR, or a comma-separated list of IPs (e.g. '192.168.1.1, 192.168.1.5'). Leave blank for auto-detect.

get_network_info.description: Returns the local IP address and subnet mask of the host machine.
